config.inference_compute: Odd inference evaluates phi twice; ordinary needs one evaluation without the swap diagnostic. Both training arms process the same2n derived examples
config.pair: Lag8 only: full invariant array[N,8,19,6,3][:,:,:,3,:], flattened456
config.swap: Each sorted log-eigenvalue triple s maps to -reverse(s); swap TWO chronological8framewindows, not the entire recorded time axis
config.stats: Raw column mean/SD on sourceTRAIN [x,Sx] only; SDfloor.001
config.bandwidth: Median squared distance of128 fixed sourceTRAIN augmented samples after raw normalization
config.basis: Same seed2027/W456x512/phases for both arms; both evaluate phi(x) and phi(Sx)
config.odd: (phi(x)-phi(Sx))/2 divided by sourceTRAIN RMS; floor.001; no odd centering or target intercept
config.equation: Both arms process2n TRAIN examples [x,Sx] with [delta,-delta]; (X.TX+2n*alpha*I)W=X.TY. Derived negative targets are not independent measurements or new labels
config.selection: Smallest ORIGINAL chronological source-validation raw displacement MSE; first alpha wins ties
config.gate: Exactodd rawdeltaR2>0 and better than fixedwithinrecordshuffle in all3rooms; oddMSE<=matchedaugordinaryMSE everyroom and strictlybetter at leastone
config.scope: FULL27-ACTION SOURCE DEVELOPMENT E01-E03, one seed; no E04, target calibration, global position, 3D or complete pose claim
